## Purpose
A root convenience manifest whose scripts proxy to the frontends.

## Settings that matter
- `name: "mistral-dynamic-agent-tools"`, private.
- **Scripts:**
  - `dev`, `build`, `preview` → `npm --prefix frontend-3 run …`;
  - `dev:legacy` → `npm --prefix frontend run dev`.

## Read by
`npm run dev` at the repo root.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
It has no dependencies of its own.

## How to rebuild this file
Copy it as is.
